cohort: The study included 131 pregnant participants who prospectively underwent both US and MRI examinations prior to delivery for suspected placenta accreta spectrum disorders.
finding: Overall, MRI and US demonstrated comparable diagnostic performance for confirming PAS disorders (ACC of 0.718 for MRI and 0.702 for US), with MRI showing modestly higher performance in subgroup of placental accrete cases.
mod_finding: Prior cesarean section surgery was identified as one of the most common causes of misdiagnosis for ultrasound.
cross-section timing: Imaging examinations were performed prior to delivery, with diagnosis confirmed by surgical or pathological findings at delivery.
